source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Electric or gas dryer?
steps.body: Identify fuel type: WED/MED = electric element; WGD/MGD = gas burner.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electric dryer terminal block vs gas dryer wire harness connection.

steps.title: Electric — access terminal block
steps.body: Remove cover plate from top right rear. Verify power cord is secure at terminal block.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove cover plate from top right rear. Verify power cord is secure at terminal block.

steps.title: Neutral plug to terminal block center
steps.body: Ohmmeter: continuity between plug neutral (N) and center terminal block contact.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohmmeter: continuity between plug neutral (N) and center terminal block contact.

steps.title: Identify L1 at terminal block
steps.body: Find which plug terminal connects to left-most terminal block contact (L1 / black wire). Note for step 6.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Find which plug terminal connects to left-most terminal block contact (L1 / black wire). Note for step 6.

steps.title: L1 plug to P9-2 at MCE
steps.body: Access MCE without disconnecting board wiring. Continuity from L1 plug terminal to P9-2 (black).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access MCE without disconnecting board wiring. Continuity from L1 plug terminal to P9-2 (black).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Secure terminal block wires or replace main harness / power cord.

steps.title: Neutral plug to P8-3 at MCE
steps.body: Continuity from plug neutral (N) to P8-3 (white) on machine control board.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity from plug neutral (N) to P8-3 (white) on machine control board.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace main wire harness — open neutral path to MCE.

steps.title: Gas — access power connection
steps.body: Remove rear cover plate. Verify power cord is firmly connected to wire harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove rear cover plate. Verify power cord is firmly connected to wire harness.

steps.title: Gas — neutral to P8-3
steps.body: Access MCE. Continuity from plug neutral (N) to P8-3 (white). If open, test cord neutral per Figure 6.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access MCE. Continuity from plug neutral (N) to P8-3 (white). If open, test cord neutral per Figure 6.

steps.title: Gas — L1 plug to P9-2
steps.body: Continuity from L1 plug terminal to P9-2 (black) on MCE.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity from L1 plug terminal to P9-2 (black) on MCE.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace power cord or main harness per OEM Figure 6 path.

steps.title: P5 and console housing seated
steps.body: P5 fully inserted into MCE; console electronics and housing assembly fully seated in front console.
steps.sourceExcerpt: P5 fully inserted into MCE; console electronics and housing assembly fully seated in front console.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace console electronics and housing assembly.

steps.title: Reconnect and verify console diag
steps.body: Plug in dryer. Run Console Buttons and Indicators diagnostic test from diagnostic mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in dryer. Run Console Buttons and Indicators diagnostic test from diagnostic mode.

steps.title: Replace harness or cord
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main wire harness or power cord per failed continuity path.

steps.title: Replace console assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace console electronics and housing; retest. If indicators still fail, replace MCE.

steps.title: Supply path verified
steps.oemOutcome: Line/neutral paths and console connections OK — if UI still dead, replace MCE.
